non_convex_optimization.summary: Restarts a local descent from many random points and hops between basins of the trading-utility surface, keeping the basin whose rule holds up on validation.
non_convex_optimization.implementationNote: Bridge: the optimiser is the model's trainer; it searches a tanh-linear position rule against train-span net utility on the price tape (next-open fills, round-trip cost); validation picks the generation kept; P(up) is a logistic curve of w.x+b fitted on validation. Differs from the spec: scipy basin hopping over L-BFGS-B descents, one restart per epoch. Expect: an in-sample-optimised linear rule, edge near the base rate.
non_convex_optimization.estimatedTrainingTime: seconds to a few minutes per fold (paced replay adds its own time)

Differs from the spec: none beyond the fixed model (a logistic regression) that makes the optimiser visible. Expect: close to the logistic regression entry; that is the point of comparison.
